name: Rocky Road Confectionery I
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ¾ cup walnut meats, shelled and chopped

steps: Place chocolate morsels, milk and butter into a heavy-bottomed pot. Set heat control dial at 350°F (175°C).
Begin stirring immediately. Stir constantly until chocolate is melted and milk and butter are incorporated. Stir in remaining ingredients.
Spread the mixture into the prepared pan.

culture.text: Rocky road is a type of confectionery commonly made in Australia. It is made from chunks of marshmallow in a matrix of chocolate. Common optional ingredients include peanuts and blobs of chewy, coloured gelatine-based sweets, similar to jubes.
